units.source_text: “那种诈骗，不知道他搞过多少回啰……

en.t: Who knows how many times he has pulled that kind of swindle...

units.source_text: 喏，前次，大臣和位高权重的军人为了猎鹿，在那里待了好些日子。

en.t: Look, the other day, a minister and some high-ranking military men stayed there for several days to hunt deer.

units.source_text: 他就请这些人提笔挥毫。

en.t: He had those men take up their brushes and write something for him.

units.source_text: 他本人的书法也苍劲有力，于是冒充他们的笔迹写了一二十张赝品，卖了出去。

en.t: Since his own calligraphy was also bold and forceful, he imitated their handwriting, made ten or twenty forgeries, and sold them.

units.source_text: 他只要一说是这些人上旅馆来时挥写的，谁都会相信的啊。

en.t: As long as he said they had written them when they came to the inn, anyone would believe him.

units.source_text: 据说他由此发了一笔财。

en.t: They say he made a fortune from it.

units.source_text: 在这种山中的温泉旅馆里，这样搞下去，显然会发财致富的……

en.t: At a mountain hot-spring inn like this, if he kept doing that, it was obvious he would become rich...

units.source_text: 这里的旅馆就是最好的证明。”

en.t: This inn here is the best proof of it."
